revisions.observation: 译文把模糊的"grow in power"具体化为"伤害增加了"，与实际机制不符：代码提升的是移动速度，而非伤害。
revisions.evidence: source: "You feel the guardian of this place grow in power."; target: "你感受到这个地方的守护者的伤害增加了。"; fixed_context: "m.movement_speed = m.movement_speed + 0.5 ... English grow in power; code is movement speed."

revisions.observation: OK：英文显示串误写为 void shards，实际恢复的是 Void Stars 层数，中文"虚空之星"忠于实际机制，且与邻近术语一致。
revisions.evidence: fixed_context: "Void Stars=虚空之星; ... English says void shards; code restores Void Stars stacks."; target: "恢复%d个虚空之星"

revisions.observation: OK：使用条件（格式塔激活 + 存在精神护盾或强化格式塔不在冷却）与英文及 on_pre_use 分组一致。
revisions.evidence: source: "requires Gestalt to be active and either an active psionic damage shield or Improved Gestalt off cooldown"; target: "需要格式塔处于激活状态，并且有一个精神护盾或强化格式塔不在冷却中"

revisions.observation: OK：第一次选取的确实是承受效果的 target（源生物），与技能描述用词一致，未与"受害者"混淆。
revisions.evidence: fixed_context: "first logPlayer Select the source: then getTarget stored as target ... talent info uses 源生物 和 牺牲生物"; target: "选择源生物:"

revisions.observation: 译文把"需要异变之手"错译为"需要空闲的副手"，资源/状态身份错误；副手空手另有独立提示串。
revisions.evidence: source: "You require a mutated hand!"; target: "你需要空闲的副手！"; fixed_context: "Mutated Hand=异变之手; separate empty-offhand log 你需要副手空手才能使用触手 ... Constrict logs You require a mutated hand! when getTentacleCombat is nil."

revisions.observation: OK：是射手主动打偏而非目标闪避，中文"故意打偏"方向正确，两个占位符分别对应射手名与 his/her。
revisions.evidence: fixed_context: "First %s=shooter name or Something; second=his/her. Deliberate miss, not dodge."; target: "%s故意打偏了%s的射击。"

revisions.observation: OK：相邻条件与"处于非战斗状态"均与 on_pre_use 一致；机械蜘蛛自身战斗状态另有独立提示串。
revisions.evidence: fixed_context: "rejects if self.in_combat or mecharachnid.in_combat or not adjacent/missing ... separate logs already say player vs mecharachnid must not be in combat"; target: "你需要你的机械蜘蛛与你相邻，并且你必须处于非战斗状态。"

revisions.observation: OK：中文与英文显示串一致（感知 3 回合、地面火焰 4 回合）；代码 EFF_SENSE 为 4 回合的差异属英文原串自身问题，非译文引入。
revisions.evidence: source: "see all enemies within %d spaces for the next 3 turns"; target: "在 3 回合内觉察到 %d 码内的所有敌对生物"; fixed_context: "setEffect(self.EFF_SENSE, 4, ...) ... English talent info says sense lasts the next 3 turns."
